label: Eveider locker
info: Reference Node-RED orchestration. Business rules live in Eveider and @eveider/locker-runtime, not in Function nodes.

name: Config: EVEIDER_API_BASE_URL, EVEIDER_LOCKER_API_TOKEN, LOCKER_ID, SYNC_INTERVAL_MS, RETRY_INTERVAL_MS, HARDWARE_ADAPTER
info: Do not store production secrets in this flow. Use Node-RED env or a local credential file outside git.

name: Terminal input → classify workflow
info: Deposit / driver_pickup / business_return_pickup are online-required. Recipient collection uses local credentials after pull sync.

name: POST /api/locker/actions/authorize
info: Fail closed: if Eveider is unreachable, do not OPEN. On deny, show the machine code.

name: Hardware adapter OPEN(compartment)
info: Adapter stub until the PLC protocol is known. Do not guess Modbus/OPC-UA registers.

name: Wait door opened + closed + occupancy evidence
info: Command accepted is not deposit/removal success. Occupancy sensing is adapter-configurable.

name: POST confirm(session) with stable deviceEventId
info: Retries reuse the same deviceEventId. Failures stay in the local outbox (persistent context).

name: POST cancel(session) on hardware failure / abandon
info: Releases the reserved compartment. Never confirm because OPEN was sent.

name: GET /api/locker/sync/collection-credentials?since=cursor
info: Configurable interval. Apply activate/revoke/consume locally. Persist cursor + credentials.

name: Local recipient validation → exact compartment OPEN
info: Phone + tracking + PIN hash. No pricing. No paid=true. Consume local credential before backend ack.

name: POST /api/locker/events/recipient-collection
info: Bound to synchronized credential id/version. Same deviceEventId on retry.

name: Outbox retry (persistent context)
info: Durability: Node-RED persistent context store (file-backed). Survives restart. Not Kafka.
